SCGSim is an independent downstream toolkit derived from
[gsim](https://github.com/gdsfactory/gsim). The current package maintains its own
in-tree semantic geometry builder, supported solver adapters and result readers.
External gsim and historical SGB sources are derivation provenance, not runtime
fallbacks or an automatic promise of API compatibility.

The package connects geometry and material facts to explicit computations,
then preserves the returned quantity's units, source and model context.
See [supported calculations](backend-support.qmd) and the [tutorials](examples.qmd).

## Scope

Palace Electrostatic/Eigenmode and AEDT HFSS Eigenmode/Driven, Q3D and Q2D are
implemented. Public component notebooks remain with OrPen. Palace Driven and
Magnetostatic are not implemented; Meep is outside the package scope.

SCGSim does not install a native solver, submit a prepared handoff implicitly,
or treat a result as universally accurate because a calculation completed.
The study author chooses physical assumptions and interprets the quantities.

## Derivation history {#starting-source-identities}

Historical starting-source identities are listed in the
[repository maintainer record](https://github.com/OrPenStrike/scgsim/blob/develop/MAINTAINING.md#implementation-and-project-references).
They describe origin, not additional supported APIs. The runtime uses
`scgsim.sgb`, not a direct external SGB consumer.
